title: Malicious code in create-ai-agent-setup (npm)
description: The create-ai-agent-setup npm package versions 2.0.0, 2.1.0, and 2.0.0-alpha.0 contain malicious code. Any system with this package installed or running is considered fully compromised, with potential unauthorized access to all secrets and keys stored on that system. Immediate removal of the package and rotation of all secrets from a different, uncompromised machine is strongly advised.
